structural_change: Geometry b: 259.2 x 216, 3 x 256x256 SRAM MY at x 21.6 (stack N y 86.4-209.6), std band S y 0-86.4. Pin/escape fix (HBM-IDXSEL8 10-20): the s3r route-trial overflow (138 a / 1062 b, all at the macro W face + top-left corner) came from the SRAM rd_out (256 b/macro) sitting on the W LEF face while selected_line_o leaves on the E face: 768 read bits had to go AROUND the stack (M2-M4 blocked, M5 vertical only). MY puts rd_out on the E face beside the output flops and w_mask/wd(120)/cr/rr on the W face beside the in_line path. s3r pin-flop spread 98/94 (a) 87/81 (b) came from pin flops spread over the full 200-um faces far from the S clock entry: all pins now sit at y 2-132 (in_line W 3-109 = the parent in_line_<q> slot, ctl ports W 112-132, selected E 2-109), i.e. beside the S band and the clock entry. b: stack at x 23.76 (W channel 23.76 for the write side, E channel 62.64 for read data + 592 output flops); off-lattice x (23.76 = macro_edge >= 20 um from the core edge) waived: the E read/output channel needs the width. RTL unchanged from s3r (FAN32 d0b37006f; census PASS max31; calendar registered_s3 unchanged, 0 edges). HBM-IDX6 FAN32 (10-20) successor of hidx_sel_s3q_a: same ports / timing / arithmetic (lockstep-equivalent to the s3 original), every register and combinational net <= 32 actual load pins by replicated state (kept P1 copies per consumer family, per-chunk kept flags, one-edge-ahead one-hot rotate selects from replicated fill state, per-chunk pack prefix copies, regional reset leaves). Predecessor failed the mandatory native32 census (s3q 497 drivers / max 1788; s3c d_go 61, reset leaf 115). L2H-IDXSEL s3 (LEAD3-HBM route B 10-19): ONE hardened quadrant tile of the landed IDX selector cluster ot_hbm_idx_selector_s3 (x4), own clock region; replaces the quadrant blocks of the s1/s2 single tile (GATE_STALL in CTS hold repair, one 42,772-sink root / ~7k unlanded inter-root crossings). Geometry a: 259.2 x 216 (aspect 1.2), 3 x 256x256 SRAM R0 at x 43.2 (43.2 lattice), stack N, std band S (y 0-86.4), W channel 43.2 (in_line pin flops / relays), E channel 43.2 (macro pin face + output flops); clk / rst_n on the S face (band side).
